tools.name: firmware_merge_and_uf2
tools.description: Merge embedded firmware .bin partitions at hex offsets with 0xFF flash padding into factory.bin or pack Microsoft UF2 blocks.

tools.name: elf_crash_backtrace_decode
tools.description: Decode ESP32 Backtrace: 0x400... and ARM/RISC-V PC/LR/MEPC crash logs against an ELF symbol table (.symtab).

tools.name: karnaugh_minimize_and_verilog
tools.description: Minimize 2-4 variable Boolean logic via exact Quine-McCluskey prime implicants, synthesize & lint Verilog RTL, and generate an IEEE-1364 .vcd testbench waveform.

tools.name: logic_trace_decode_wavedrom
tools.description: Decode .vcd waveforms or logic-analyzer .csv traces into UART 8N1, I2C, or SPI protocol frames and generate WaveDrom JSON + publication SVG timing diagrams.

tools.name: intel_hex_inspect
tools.description: Parse and checksum-verify Intel HEX (.hex) firmware records, extended linear addresses (04), start segment (03/05), and flash memory map.

tools.name: can_bus_decode
tools.description: Decode candump/Lawicel/CSV CAN & CAN-FD frames, extract arbitration IDs (11/29-bit), DLC, bitfield payloads, and OBD-II PIDs.

tools.name: cmake_generate
tools.description: Generate a modern CMakeLists.txt for C/C++ or ARM Cortex-M / ESP32 embedded projects with C++ standard, warnings, and target links.

tools.name: ieee754_inspect
tools.description: Inspect IEEE-754 single (float32) and double (float64) sign, exponent, mantissa bits, hex representations, and subnormal/NaN/Inf edge states.
